_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Udlala Klondike Solitaire. Inhloso yakho ukususa amakhasi wonke kwenqaba.

Imithetho yeMdlalo:
- Iqaba (F1-F4): Yakha phezulu kusuka kwa-Ace kwa-King ngosuthu
- I-Tableau (T1-T7): Yakha phansi ngokuhamba kwezimbala (ebomvu phezu kwekala, ikala phezu kwe-bomvu)
- I-Stokhi: Draya amakhasi kwenye stokhi ya-waste
- I-Waste (W): Ikhadi eliphezulu elikhona ukudlala

Izwi:
- 'draw' - Draya amakhasi kusuka kwenye stokhi kwenye stokhi ya-waste
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Susa amakhasi phakathi kwenye mpahla
  Imizekelo: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. inombolo inaweza nayo 'all', okuyohlola ukususa amakhasi wonke abheke phezulu.
- 'forfeit' - Qeda umdlalo manje nje futhi uqine iskoru yakho manje
- Amagama empahla: W (waste), F1-F4 (iqaba), T1-T7 (itableau)

Unaweza ukusebenza izwi eziningi kwenye maphinde amanye ngokuzihambanisa ngama-comma:
  Umzekelo: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Abakhozi kuphela abaweza ukubekwa kwenye itableau eyingenanto.
Izwi zisebenza ngokulandelana - ukuba eyodwa ifele, izwi ezisale ziyashiywa.
Sebenzisa 'forfeit' ukuba ukholelwa umdlalo uwezekana ukunqoba.

format_error.no_brackets: Ifomethi yesenzo engekho emthethweni. Isenzo kufanele sibe phakathi kwama-brackets.
format_error.move_needs_args: Umyalo we-move udinga umthombo nendawo okuyiwa kuyo. Ukusetshenziswa: 'move <source> <destination> [count]'

move_result.drew: Wadonsa ikhadi (s) kusukela esitokisini kuya imfucuza.
move_result.cannot_draw: Ayikwazi ukudonswa. Kokubili isitoko nemfucumfucu kuphelile.
move_result.invalid_pile: Igama lenqwaba elingalungile. Sebenzisa u-W, F1-F4, noma u-T1-T7
move_result.foundation_one_card: Ungakwazi ukuhambisa ikhadi elilodwa kuphela esisekelweni
move_result.waste_to_foundation_bad: Ayikwazi ukuhambisa ikhadi elilahliwe kuleyo nqwaba yesisekelo
move_result.tableau_to_foundation_ok: Ikhadi elifakwe kusuka etafuleni T{src} kuya esisekelweni F{dst}
move_result.tableau_to_foundation_bad: Ayikwazi ukuhambisa ikhadi le-tableau kuleyo nqwaba yesisekelo
move_result.waste_to_tableau_one_card: Kungahanjiswa ikhadi elilodwa kuphela kusuka ku-waste kuya ku-tableau
move_result.waste_to_tableau_ok: Ikhadi elifakwe kusuka emfucumfucwini kuya ku-table T{dst}
move_result.waste_to_tableau_bad: Ayikwazi ukubeka ikhadi elilahliwe kuleyo nqwaba yethebhu
move_result.no_face_up: Awekho amakhadi abheke phezulu okufanele ahambe
move_result.tableau_to_tableau_ok: Kususwe {count} ikhadi (s) kusuka etafuleni T{src} kuya ku-T{dst}
move_result.tableau_to_tableau_bad: Ayikwazi ukuhambisa {count} ikhadi (s) kusuka ku-T{src} kuya ku-T{dst}
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_one_card: Kungahanjiswa ikhadi elilodwa kuphela kusuka esisekelweni kuya etafuleni
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_ok: Ikhadi elifakwe esisekelweni F{src} liye etafuleni T{dst}
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_bad: Ayikwazi ukubeka ikhadi lesisekelo etafuleni T{dst}

outcome.forfeit: Umdlalo ulahliwe. Isilinganiso sokugcina: {score} amakhadi ezisekelweni.
outcome.turn_limit: Umdlalo uphelile! Usufinyelele inani eliphakeme le-{max_turns} ukuphenduka. Umphumela: {score} amakhadi ezisekelweni.
